objective: Preallocate INSERT schema lookup keys from table-name length.

tasks.title: Preallocate INSERT schema keys
tasks.result: INSERT schema lookup paths now use an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for schema:<table> keys.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for schema:<table> before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in INSERT schema lookup key construction for both InsertRowsContext and regular INSERT handling.
Generated schema key bytes, schema loads, insert planning, COPY direct-path context, constraints, indexes, and SQL DML results are unchanged.
Focused INSERT tests run in parallel printed Cargo file-lock waits before passing.
Full sql_dml passed while printing existing sstable retry and slow-query logs.
